items.prompt: Why not order groups by root?

options.why: Union by size does not promise that a component root is its minimum member.
The roots identify DSU representatives; they are not correlation or price values.
Representative choice depends on union history; canonical display sorts members and groups by their smallest member instead.
Roots here are integer vertex IDs; the problem is their arbitrary ordering, not their type.

items.explanation: Union by size is not a canonical display policy.
